name: How accurate are online home value estimates?

mainEntity.name: How accurate are online home value estimates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Online home value estimates can provide a general starting point but often lack precision. They typically rely on algorithms using public data and may not account for unique property upgrades, specific neighborhood nuances, or current market shifts. For a more accurate valuation, especially in diverse markets like Brickell or Coconut Grove, a professional evaluation by an experienced local real estate agent is recommended as they can physically inspect the property and consider micro-market trends.
acceptedAnswer.description: Online estimates are general and may not account for unique property features or local market nuances; a professional agent provides a more accurate valuation.
